summary: Chat citations don't render live (only after refresh): parser too strict for real model CITATIONS formats
description:
Regression from todo:50b9a90a (strip CITATIONS tail from chat, render styled cards from parseCitationsBlock).

SYMPTOM: chat citation cards do not appear during the live stream; they only show after a page refresh.

ROOT CAUSE: live path renders cards from parseCitationsBlock(streamed text); refresh path rehydrates from chunks_used -> corpus.chunks (authoritative). The parser only accepted the documented '[tradition | text | section | TIER: x]' line ending exactly in ']'. Real model output (confirmed from queries rows) uses two other shapes:
  1. bracketed + inline quote on same line: [a | b | c | tier: x] "quote..."  (line doesn't end in ']')
  2. index-prefixed, unbracketed fields echoing the SOURCE PASSAGES input shape: [7] neoplatonism | b | c | Tier: verified
Both yielded zero parsed citations -> no live cards. Refresh path bypasses the parser, hence 'only after refresh'.

FIX: added extractFields() in src/lib/citations.ts tolerating both formats (+ leading tier glyph, inline-quote preference). Strict documented format still parses identically.

TESTS: 3 regression tests added to src/__tests__/citations.test.ts; full suite 530 passed, typecheck clean.

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: Original capture framed the parser strictness as THE fix. That was necessary but NOT sufficient: with next dev + HMR running, the parser fix was live and the bug persisted. Real root cause is architectural — the live chat render reconstructed citations by PARSING the model's free-text CITATIONS tail, while refresh rehydrates from authoritative chunks_used -> corpus.chunks. Model output varies too much (inline quotes, index-prefixed/unbracketed entries, block omitted under output-token cap) for parsing to be reliable. FIX: /api/query now emits the retrieved chunks_used set in an X-Citations header (mirroring X-Model-Used/X-Query-Expansion); chat-view seeds msg.citations from it so cards render live, identical to refresh, independent of model formatting. Parser hardening retained as fallback (serves the hand-authored blog path).

resolution.test_function: POST /api/query > surfaces retrieved chunks as authoritative citations in the X-Citations header (todo:2fd21c61)
resolution.note: Root cause was architectural, not just parser strictness: live render parsed the model's free-text CITATIONS tail while refresh used authoritative chunks_used. Fix emits X-Citations header from retrieved chunks; chat-view seeds msg.citations so cards render live, identical to refresh. Parser hardening kept as fallback. Verified: 110 tests pass (api + chat-view + citations + chat-citations), tsc clean.
